title.en: Measures of Money Supply in India
title.hi: Measures of Money Supply in India

definition.en: Money supply refers to the total stock of money circulating in an economy at a particular point in time, measured by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) using specific monetary aggregates.
definition.hi: Money supply refers to the total stock of money circulating in an economy at a particular point in time, measured by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) using specific monetary aggregates.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding money supply is critical for GS-3 as it directly impacts inflation, interest rates, and liquidity management by the RBI. UPSC frequently tests the components of M1, M2, M3, and M4 to evaluate a candidate's grasp of monetary policy and macroeconomic stability.
